6. Cross-check "group_names_normalized.txt" against "group_sanitized.txt" to detect duplicate or inconsistent entries and record any discrepancies in "group_conflicts.log".  
7. Resolve duplicates noted in "group_conflicts.log" and produce a final verified list "groups_verified.txt" containing one confirmed group name per line.

{"script":"WORKDIR="$(pwd)/group_inspect_workspace"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
cp /etc/group "$WORKDIR/group_raw.txt"
# Sanitize: remove empty lines and trim whitespace
awk 'NF{gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"") ; print}' "$WORKDIR/group_raw.txt" > "$WORKDIR/group_sanitized.txt"
# Extract group name field
awk -F: '{print $1}' "$WORKDIR/group_sanitized.txt" > "$WORKDIR/group_names.txt"
# Normalize: lowercase and remove blanks
awk 'NF{print tolower($0)}' "$WORKDIR/group_names.txt" | sed '/^$/d' > "$WORKDIR/group_names_normalized.txt"
# Prepare conflict log (clear or create)
: > "$WORKDIR/group_conflicts.log"
# Find duplicated normalized names
cd "$WORKDIR"
duplicates=$(awk -F: '{print tolower($1)}' group_sanitized.txt | sort | uniq -d)
if [ -n "$duplicates" ]; then
  for dup in $duplicates; do
    echo "=== CONFLICT: $dup ===" >> group_conflicts.log
    awk -F: -v key="$dup" 'BEGIN{kw=key} { if(tolower($1)==kw) print }' group_sanitized.txt >> group_conflicts.log
    echo >> group_conflicts.log
  done
fi
# Also check for inconsistencies where same normalized maps to different exact names
# (This is largely covered by duplicates above)

# Resolve duplicates: choose first-seen original group name for each normalized key
awk -F: '{ key=tolower($1); if(!(key in seen)){ seen[key]=1; print $1 > "groups_verified.tmp" } }
' group_sanitized.txt
# Ensure unique and one per normalized name
# groups_verified.tmp already has one chosen original per normalized key in order of appearance
mv groups_verified.tmp groups_verified.txt
# Final verification: sort unique to have deterministic order
sort -u groups_verified.txt -o groups_verified.txt

# Output path and count
COUNT=$(wc -l < groups_verified.txt)
printf "%s\n%s\n" "VERIFIED_PATH=$WORKDIR/groups_verified.txt" "GROUP_COUNT=$COUNT"
"}
